When Pluto conjoins the North Node, power and forward movement meet, making leverage part of the plan rather than a side issue. A negotiation, transfer of authority, new source of funding, boundary, or exit from an unequal arrangement may matter more than another round of imagining the desired future. Wanting change and having the ability to carry it out are separate problems.
